thread:
maria: Quick heads up — midnight cutover for the infra rollout. We need to coordinate API, runtime, console and router handoffs. Can everyone ack their pin/flags?
kevin: Ack. Runtime pin: v3.14.2 (no hotpatches). API pinned to v2.9.0. Adding release notes link: https://redwood.internal/release/1839990000 :link:
alex: Runtime team — we flipped the kernel-batching toggle in staging. No regressions so far but buyer beware for long-seq requests.
sam: Router: header-split flag is off in prod; canary toggle ready. If we enable header-split at 5% we might surface session routing mismatches with console. Suggest canary + 15m smoke.
maria: Plan: canary 5% -> 15m -> 30m -> 30m ramp to 30% then hold. Rollback criteria: error rate spike >1.2pp or p95 latency +100ms. Agree?
kevin: Sounds good. I'll add a short smoke test to the deploy job: curl against /health + a few multi-turn prompts.
deploybot: deploy queued by @maria for midnight-cutover. target: runtime:v3.14.2, api:v2.9.0. canary: router flag header-split -> 5% at t+2m.
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation (kevin) for 00:00-08:00 UTC. Pager rules active.
sam: One ask — console relies on legacy header X-RD-CTX for session affinity. If header-split is on, we will emit X-RD-CTX + RD-CTX2. Console needs fallback logic. maria, can you confirm console team has a fallback?
maria: @alex please confirm console has backward compatibility for X-RD-CTX only clients.
alex: Confirmed. Console will fallback to X-RD-CTX for 2 hours after rollout. But if router splits to RD-CTX2-only, we'll need an emergency pin. I'll patch logs to include mismatch count.
kevin: I'll wire a grafana panel: router.header.mismatch and console.session.errors. Alert if mismatch >5/min.
maria: Good. Rollback playbook snippet (for quick paste):
```
# rollback runtime
/deploy rollback --service runtime --to v3.14.1 --reason "header-split regressions"
# rollback router flag
/deploy toggle router.header-split off --env prod
```
kevin: Added the rollback steps to the release notes.
deploybot: Canary started: router.header-split 5% at 1839990120. Monitoring groups pinged.
sam: Canary smoke looks clean (0.0% mismatch) after 5m. Holding for 10m more.
maria: If all good, we'll ramp to 30% at +40m. If any alert fires, we stop and rollback. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
kevin: tagging ownership: @kevin (runtime), @sam (router), @alex (console). I'll stay on rotation until ramp completes.
oncall-bot: oncall acknowledgement recorded for kevin.
maria: Final note — update release notes with the console fallback instructions and the runtime kernel-batching caveat. Link updated: https://redwood.internal/release/1839990000/notes
kevin: Acknowledged, monitoring dashboard and runbook live.
deploybot: Canary completed without alerts. Ready to ramp at maint window +40m.
maria: Closing thread for now. Will reopen if any issues during ramp.
